name: AngularBlur
description: Radial motion blur rotating around a center point

intensity.description: Intensity of the angular blur effect

center.description: The center point of the rotation

dispersion.description: Spectral color fringing along the streak, like light through a lens; negative flips which end is red

falloff.description: Concentrates the dispersion away from the center; 0 fringes everywhere equally

focus.description: Radius of a clean zone around the center that stays sharp

bias.description: Trails the sweep off one side of each pixel instead of both; the sign picks the direction

highlights.description: Lets bright pixels streak further than dark ones, like light rays

jitter.description: Per-pixel noise on the tap spacing that hides banding in long streaks

name: Arc
description: Pie sector (arc wedge) with adjustable radius and aperture angle

origin.description: Reference edge the center position is measured from (center default). Lets you pin the shape relative to a corner or the canvas centre.

center.description: Center position of the arc

radius.description: Radius of the pie sector

aperture.description: Aperture angle of the wedge in degrees (360 = full circle)

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees

softness.description: Edge softness for antialiasing

strokeThickness.description: Stroke thickness. Zero means no stroke.

strokePosition.description: Position of the stroke relative to the shape edge

colorSpace.description: Color space for blending fill and stroke colors

name: Ascii
description: Convert imagery to ASCII character art

characters.description: Characters ordered from dense to sparse. First character is used for bright areas, last for dark areas.

cellSize.description: Size of each ASCII character cell (normalized to 1080p reference, scales proportionally at other resolutions)

spacing.description: Character size within each cell (1.0 = optimal size, 0.0 = smallest)

gamma.description: Brightness curve adjustment. <1 brightens darks (more light characters), >1 darkens midtones (more dark characters). Use to better fit characters to image brightness range.

alphaThreshold.description: Pixels with alpha below this threshold become fully transparent.

preserveAlpha.description: When enabled, output alpha matches input alpha. When disabled, pixels above the alpha threshold become fully opaque.

name: Aurora
description: Mesmerizing aurora borealis with layered curtains, vertical rays, and flowing light.

colorA.description: Edge color at the curtain base

colorB.description: Core color in the bright center

colorC.description: Tip color at the ray ends

balance.description: Shifts color distribution across the curtain height

intensity.description: Overall aurora brightness

speed.description: Animation speed

center.description: Center position of the aurora

seed.description: Random seed for variation

name: BarnDoors
description: Split the content along a center line and wipe outward in both directions

progress.description: How far the doors have opened (0 = fully visible, 1 = fully wiped away)

angle.description: Direction the doors open in degrees (0 = apart horizontally)

invert.description: Close in from both edges instead of opening from the center

name: BarShift
description: Slices content into parallel bars, each offset independently for a fractured or glitch-like effect

count.description: Number of bars across the longest viewport dimension

angle.description: Angle of bar orientation in degrees (0 = vertical bars, 90 = horizontal bars)

intensity.description: Maximum displacement per bar

seed.description: Randomization seed for per-bar offset variation

speed.description: Animation speed — each bar drifts at its own rate and direction

edges.description: How to handle edges when distortion pushes content out of bounds

name: Beam
description: A beam of light from one point to another.

startThickness.description: Thickness at the start of the beam

endThickness.description: Thickness at the end of the beam

startSoftness.description: Edge softness at the start of the beam

endSoftness.description: Edge softness at the end of the beam

insideColor.description: Color at the center of the beam

outsideColor.description: Color at the edges of the beam

name: Bend
description: Bends the ends of the frame toward you like a curved display — content at the edges swells closer under real perspective, or curls away when the strength goes negative

strength.description: How hard the ends bend — positive curls them toward you (edges magnify), negative curls them away (edges recede into the frame)

angle.description: Direction of the bend axis in degrees — 0 bends the left/right ends, 90 bends the top/bottom

edges.description: How to handle edges when the bend pulls content away from the frame border

name: Blob
description: Organic animated blob with 3D lighting and gradients

origin.description: Reference edge the center position is measured from (center default). Lets you pin the shape relative to a corner or the canvas centre.

stops.description: Multi-stop gradient colors (overrides Color A / Color B when set)

deformation.description: How organic and blobby the shape is (0 = circle, 1 = very blobby)

softness.description: Softness of the blob edges (combines edge width and transition curve)

speed.description: Animation speed

seed.description: Adjusts the starting state, useful for variation

center.description: The center point of the blob

name: BlockDissolve
description: Dissolve the content away as a grid of blocks vanishing in random order

progress.description: How far the dissolve has progressed (0 = fully visible, 1 = fully wiped away)

blockSize.description: Size of each block as a fraction of the frame width

softness.description: How softly each block fades out (0 = hard-edged blocks)

invert.description: Reverse the order blocks dissolve in

name: BlockNoise
description: Blocky value noise with soft cells that morph over time

stops.description: Multi-stop gradient colors (overrides Color A / Color B when set)

scale.description: Pattern scale (higher = larger patterns)

balance.description: Balance between colors (negative = more colorB, positive = more colorA)

seed.description: Random seed for pattern variation

speed.description: Animation speed

name: BlueNoise
description: High-frequency blue noise — even, grainy speckle ideal for dithering

stops.description: Multi-stop gradient colors (overrides Color A / Color B when set)

grain.description: Grain size in pixels (1 = per-pixel, higher = chunkier speckle)

balance.description: Balance between colors (negative = more colorB, positive = more colorA)

seed.description: Random seed for pattern variation

name: Blur
description: A simple Gaussian blur effect

intensity.description: Intensity of the blur effect

name: Boids
description: A living murmuration of hundreds of flocking agents drawn as crisp arrows, streaks, dots or glowing comets — separation, alignment and cohesion drive fluid, splitting-and-merging ribbons, agents flash toward an excited color when scattered, and the cursor acts as an attractor or a predator

colorB.description: Color agents flash toward when agitated — scattering from the predator cursor or banking through a hard turn

colorSpace.description: Color space for the rest→excited color ramp

agentShape.description: What each agent is drawn as — a hard-edged arrow, streak or square pointing along its heading, a plain dot, or a soft glowing comet

speed.description: Overall cruising speed of the flock

seed.description: Re-rolls the flock's starting formation — each value spawns the murmuration in a different arrangement

trails.description: How long each agent's motion trail persists — 0 draws crisp agents, 1 leaves long ribbons

separation.description: How strongly agents steer away from crowding their neighbours

alignment.description: How strongly agents match their neighbours' heading — the driver of coherent murmuration ribbons

cohesion.description: How strongly agents steer toward the local center of the flock

perception.description: How far each agent can sense its neighbours (in screen heights) — larger sees bigger, smoother flocks

cursorMode.description: How the flock reacts to the cursor

cursorStrength.description: Strength of the cursor's pull or push on the flock

radius.description: Defocus amount — how far the lens blur spreads

highlightGain.description: How strongly bright highlights bloom into discs

highlightThreshold.description: Brightness above which a highlight forms a disc

bladeShape.description: Aperture shape the highlights bloom into — bladed iris or a novelty cut-out (heart, star, …)

bladeRotation.description: Rotation of the aperture shape (in degrees)

mortar.description: Width of mortar gaps — equal pixel thickness in both directions

seed.description: Random seed for per-row speed variation

name: BrightnessContrast
description: Adjust brightness and contrast of the image

bevelWidth.description: Width of the edge bevel, relative to the shape — thin for machined jewellery edges, wide for soft pillowed metal

edgeSoftness.description: Softness of the shape boundary edge

name: Bulge

strength.description: The intensity of the bulge effect (positive = bulge out, negative = pinch in)

radius.description: The radius of the bulge effect area

falloff.description: Controls the smoothness of the transition (0 = hard edge, 1 = very smooth)

edges.description: How to handle edges when distortion pushes content out of bounds

bevelWidth.description: Width of the edge bevel, relative to the shape — thin for machined jewellery edges, wide for soft pillowed metal

edgeSoftness.description: Softness of the shape boundary edge

edgeThickness.description: Thickness of the chalk outline strokes

shading.description: Amount of cross-hatch shading filling darker regions

hatchScale.description: Spacing of the cross-hatch lines in pixels

grain.description: Chalk dustiness / grain that breaks up the strokes

name: ChannelBlur
description: Independent blur for red, green, and blue channels

description: Classic checkerboard pattern with two alternating colors

colorA.description: First color of the checkerboard pattern

softness.description: Smoothness of the transition between colors (0 = hard edges, 1 = very soft)

description: Wipe the content away as a checkerboard of fading squares

softness.description: Edge softness

speed.description: Animation speed

description: Separate RGB channels for a prismatic distortion effect

strength.description: Overall strength of the chromatic aberration effect

angle.description: Direction of the chromatic aberration in degrees

name: Chrome
description: Studio-lit mirror chrome — a precision-machined shape with a controllable polished bevel, softly convex faces and a photographic studio reflected in them: one huge frontal softbox, black flags, and thin warm/cool strip lights that fringe amber and ice-blue exactly where the reflections break

origin.description: Reference edge the center position is measured from (center default). Lets you pin the shape relative to a corner or the canvas centre.

center.description: Center position of the chrome shape

scale.description: Scale of the chrome shape (1 = default size)

rotation.description: Rotation of the chrome shape in degrees

tint.description: Metal tint multiplied into the reflection — white for silver chrome, warm ivory for gold, dusky rose for copper

coolColor.description: Color of the cool wash below the horizon — the steel-blue zone the darker reflections fall into

bevelWidth.description: Width of the polished edge bevel, relative to the shape — thin for machined jewellery edges, wide for soft pillowed metal

bevelShape.description: Bevel profile — 0 = one smooth round fillet, 1 = machined: a steep outer fillet, a chamfer plateau and an inner knee, each catching its own line of light

curvature.description: Convex doming of the faces — sweeps the big soft studio gradients across otherwise flat metal

colorB.description: Second palette color — blended in by height, depth, per voxel or on the side faces

colorMode.description: How the two colors are laid over the model: one solid color, a gradient by height or depth, a random pick per voxel, or Color A on top faces and Color B on the sides

colorVariation.description: Per-voxel tonal jitter — the slightly-off shades that make blocks read as individual bricks

lightAngle.description: Direction the key light comes from, in degrees around the canvas — shadows fall away from it

lightElevation.description: How high the key light sits above the canvas — low for long raking shadows, high for a flat top-down light

ambientColor.description: Sky color of the ambient light — the fill on faces the key light misses

ambient.description: Strength of the ambient sky/ground fill

shadows.description: Darkness of the shadows voxels cast onto each other

shadowSoftness.description: Penumbra of the cast shadows — 0 is razor sharp, higher spreads the light into a soft area source whose shadows sharpen at contact

ao.description: Ambient occlusion in the creases between voxels — the soft contact darkening that sells the geometry

glossiness.description: How tight the specular highlight is — satin plastic at 0, lacquered at 1

specular.description: Strength of the specular highlight and the fresnel rim on grazing faces

seams.description: Dark seam lines along every voxel edge — 0 for seamless blocks, higher for a drawn-outline brick look

shapeSdfUrl.description: URL to a pre-generated SDF .bin file

name: Water
description: Translucent water — a refractive, light-absorbing body that deepens to its color with thickness, wrapped in a wind-driven wave surface that reflects a procedural sky, with Fresnel-bright grazing edges and foam breaking on the crests and shoreline

origin.description: Reference edge the center position is measured from (center default). Lets you pin the shape relative to a corner or the canvas centre.

center.description: Center position of the water shape

scale.description: Scale of the water shape (1 = default size)

rotation.description: Rotation of the water shape in degrees

waterColor.description: The color the water saturates toward with depth

clarity.description: How much of the reflected sky transmits through the body

depth.description: How quickly the water darkens and saturates toward its color with thickness

shallows.description: Brightness of the thin shallow water at the edges — high fades the rim to light translucent water, low keeps the edges close to the deep water color

caustics.description: Intensity of the light caustics bubbling up through the body — bright veins of focused light churning inside the water

causticScale.description: Size of the caustic veins — higher = finer, busier light patterns inside the body

choppiness.description: Height of the wind-driven waves — the depth of the folds that bend the reflection

waveScale.description: Scale of the wave fronts — higher = smaller, busier ripples

swirl.description: Swirl of the flow — domain-warps the wave fronts into curling eddies

speed.description: Speed of the rolling waves. 0 pauses the surface.

reflection.description: Strength of the reflected sky across the surface

envRotation.description: Rotates the reflected sky — spins where the bright sky and sun fall

sharpness.description: Tightness of the sun glint and reflected sun

lightAngle.description: Direction of the sun, in degrees — drives the glint and where the sun reflects

foam.description: White foam breaking on the wave crests and along the shoreline edge

edgeSoftness.description: Softness of the shape boundary edge

shapeSdfUrl.description: URL to a pre-generated SDF .bin file

name: Watercolor
description: Painterly watercolor look — Kuwahara flattening, pigment edge darkening, paper grain and bleeding

radius.description: Brush size — radius of the painterly flattening

bleed.description: Amount the pigment bleeds and wobbles past hard edges

strength.description: Blend between the original image (0) and the full watercolor effect (1)

paper.description: Strength of the paper grain the pigment settles into

name: WaveDistortion
description: Wave-based distortion with multiple waveform types

speed.description: Animation speed

angle.description: Direction of wave distortion in degrees

edges.description: How to handle edges when distortion pushes content out of bounds

name: Waveform
description: Audio-visualizer waveform — equalizer bars, a filled wave, an oscilloscope line, or a dot matrix — driven by a simulated signal whose amplitude you can map to your own audio level

style.description: Visualizer style: equalizer bars, a filled wave envelope, an oscilloscope line, or a dot matrix

stops.description: Multi-stop gradient colors (overrides Color A / Color B when set)

colorSpace.description: Color space for the start→end gradient

from.description: Where the waveform starts (Color A end)

to.description: Where the waveform ends (Color B end)

amplitude.description: Overall signal level (0 = silence). Map this to your own audio level to make the waveform react to real sound.

frequency.description: How busy the signal is across the width (higher = more peaks)

height.description: Maximum vertical extent of the waveform as a fraction of the canvas height

align.description: Which side of the start→end baseline the waveform grows on: mirrored around it, above it (top), or below it (bottom)

count.description: Number of bars (or dot columns) across the width

barWidth.description: Bar thickness as a fraction of its column (1 = bars touch)

rounding.description: Rounds the bar ends (0 = square, 1 = fully rounded caps)

dotSize.description: Dot diameter as a fraction of its cell

lineWidth.description: Stroke thickness of the line. A value of one (1) matches the canvas height.

softness.description: Feathers the wave's edge into a glow

speed.description: Animation speed of the simulated signal

seed.description: Adjusts the starting state, useful for variation

name: WaveletNoise
description: Rotating banded wavelets that ripple as they animate

stops.description: Multi-stop gradient colors (overrides Color A / Color B when set)

scale.description: Pattern scale (higher = larger patterns)

detail.description: Per-octave frequency ratio — higher adds finer wavelet detail

balance.description: Balance between colors (negative = more colorB, positive = more colorA)

seed.description: Random seed for pattern variation

speed.description: Animation speed

name: Weave
description: Interlaced textile weave pattern with two thread colors going over and under each other

cells.description: Number of threads across the shortest canvas edge

gap.description: Gap between threads (0 = no gap, 0.5 = maximum gap)

rotation.description: Rotation of the weave pattern in degrees

name: WebcamTexture
description: Display a live webcam feed with customizable object-fit modes

objectFit.description: How the webcam feed should be sized within the viewport

mirror.description: Mirror the webcam feed horizontally (selfie mode)

name: Wool
description: Applies an interwoven fibrous fabric texture and distortion to child content

intensity.description: Strength of the relief shading applied to the child content

scale.description: Scale of the pattern — lower = larger features, higher = finer grain

contrast.description: Contrast of the texture — negative flattens it into a subtle overlay

distortion.description: Surface distortion — warps the child along the texture like carved relief

seed.description: Random seed for pattern variation

name: WorleyNoise
description: Cellular noise field — distance-based, with selectable feature combinations and fractal octaves

colorA.description: Color where the noise field is low (typically near cell centers)

colorB.description: Color where the noise field is high (typically near cell boundaries)

scale.description: Number of cells across the canvas at the base octave

mode.description: Field type. F1 = distance to nearest point. F2 = distance to second-nearest. F2 − F1 emphasises cell boundaries.

distance.description: Distance metric. Euclidean = round cells. Manhattan = diamond. Chebyshev = square.

octaves.description: Number of fractal layers stacked at progressively finer scales

lacunarity.description: Scale multiplier between octaves (only active when Octaves > 1)

persistence.description: Amplitude multiplier between octaves (only active when Octaves > 1)

jitter.description: How much each cell's point drifts inside its cell. 0 = rigid grid (banded look), 1 = fully random.

contrast.description: Steepness of the gradient between low and high regions

balance.description: Shifts the gradient midpoint. Negative pulls the field toward Color A, positive toward Color B.

seed.description: Random seed — shifts the cell pattern without changing its overall structure

speed.description: Animation speed — how fast each cell's point drifts

name: ZoomBlur
description: Radial zoom blur expanding from a center point

intensity.description: Intensity of the zoom blur effect

center.description: Center point of the zoom blur

dispersion.description: Spectral color fringing along the streak, like light through a lens; negative flips which end is red

falloff.description: Concentrates the dispersion away from the center; 0 fringes everywhere equally

focus.description: Radius of a clean zone around the center that stays sharp

bias.description: Slides the streak window: 0 streaks inward from each pixel, 1 streaks evenly both ways, -1 pushes it further in

highlights.description: Lets bright pixels streak further than dark ones, like light rays

spiral.description: Twists the radial streak into a vortex around the center

jitter.description: Per-pixel noise on the tap spacing that hides banding in long streaks
